data.one_liner: Customizable progress indicators, gauges, circular percent indicators, and dots in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a comprehensive collection of progress indicators and gauges for Flutter applications. Supports linear progress bars, circular percent indicators, radial and linear gauges, dots indicators, and multi-segment bars with animations and gradients.
use_when: You need linear or circular progress indicators with gradients and animations.
You want to display speedometer-style gauges, radial gauges, or linear gauges.
You need step-based dot indicators or multi-segment progress bars.
avoid_when: You only need the built-in Material LinearProgressIndicator or CircularProgressIndicator with zero customization.
You are building complex data charts that require fully interactive multi-series plotting.
strengths: Extensive variety of widgets including gauges, linear, circular, and multi-segment indicators.
Rich customization options like gradients, needles, ticks, ranges, and smooth animations.
Includes decorators for quick preset configurations.
weaknesses: Large API surface with many separate components to learn.
Not documented if it has any advanced accessibility features beyond basic semantics.
data.minimal_example:
LinearProgressBar(
  maxSteps: 6,
  progressType: ProgressType.linear,
  currentStep: 3,
  progressColor: Colors.blue,
  backgroundColor: Colors.grey,
)
